linkedin.text:
A board-level gathering is judged in the first ninety seconds, before anyone speaks. The room does that work or it does not.

This is Budapest, from a programme we produced. A city built at nineteenth-century scale, where the rooms match the skyline and a group of thirty feels significant rather than sparse.

Small senior groups are deceptively hard. Thirty people in a room built for three hundred feels like a failure, and thirty people in a room built for thirty feels cramped the moment coffee arrives. The right answer is usually a grand room with a defined seating footprint inside it — you use the volume without trying to fill it.

That is a briefing detail most venues will not raise with you, because it is easier to sell you the bigger room.

Building a board or leadership offsite for 2026? Tell us the headcount and we will size the room to it properly.
